mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO wallet_account (owner_type, owner_id, account_type, currency, available_balance, pending_balance, version, status) VALUES (#{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{accountType}, 'XU', 0, 0, 0, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_type AS ownerType, owner_id AS ownerId, account_type AS accountType, available_balance AS availableBalance, version FROM wallet_account WHERE owner_type = #{ownerType} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND account_type = #{accountType} AND currency = 'XU' AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DEBT') LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ledger_transaction (transaction_no, idempotency_key, request_hash, business_type, business_id, currency, total_amount, reversal_of_transaction_id, description) VALUES (#{transactionNo}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, 'XU', #{totalAmount}, #{reversalOfTransactionId}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT id, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, request_hash AS requestHash, business_type AS businessType, business_id AS businessId, total_amount AS totalAmount, reversal_of_transaction_id AS reversalOfTransactionId FROM ledger_transaction WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT we.wallet_account_id AS walletAccountId, wa.owner_type AS ownerType, wa.owner_id AS ownerId, wa.account_type AS accountType, we.amount FROM wallet_entry we JOIN wallet_account wa ON wa.id = we.wallet_account_id WHERE we.ledger_transaction_id = #{transactionId} ORDER BY we.wallet_account_id
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_account SET status = CASE WHEN owner_type = 'USER' AND account_type = 'READER_XU' THEN CASE WHEN available_balance + #{amount} < 0 THEN 'DEBT' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END ELSE status END, available_balance = available_balance + #{amount}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{walletId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND (owner_type = 'SYSTEM' OR available_balance + #{amount} >= 0)

UPDATE wallet_account SET status = CASE WHEN owner_type = 'USER' AND account_type = 'READER_XU' THEN CASE WHEN available_balance + #{amount} < 0 THEN 'DEBT' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END ELSE status END, available_balance = available_balance + #{amount}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{walletId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND (owner_type = 'SYSTEM' OR available_balance + #{amount} >= 0 OR (owner_type = 'USER' AND account_type = 'READER_XU'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_entry (ledger_transaction_id, wallet_account_id, amount, balance_after) VALUES (#{transactionId}, #{walletId}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter})
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET account_balance = #{balance}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wallet_entry we JOIN wallet_account wa ON wa.id = we.wallet_account_id WHERE wa.owner_type = 'USER' AND wa.owner_id = #{userId} AND wa.account_type = 'READER_XU' AND wa.currency = 'XU'

SELECT lt.transaction_no AS transactionNo, lt.business_type AS businessType, lt.business_id AS businessId, we.amount, we.balance_after AS balanceAfter, lt.description, we.create_time AS createTime FROM wallet_entry we JOIN wallet_account wa ON wa.id = we.wallet_account_id JOIN ledger_transaction lt ON lt.id = we.ledger_transaction_id WHERE wa.owner_type = 'USER' AND wa.owner_id = #{userId} AND wa.account_type = 'READER_XU' AND wa.currency = 'XU' ORDER BY we.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT available_balance FROM wallet_account WHERE owner_type = 'AUTHOR' AND owner_id = #{authorId} AND account_type = 'AUTHOR_REVENUE_XU' AND currency = 'XU' AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
SELECT ledger_transaction_id, SUM(amount) AS sum_amount FROM wallet_entry GROUP BY ledger_transaction_id HAVING SUM(amount) != 0

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.account_balance, wa.available_balance FROM user u JOIN wallet_account wa ON u.id = wa.owner_id WHERE wa.owner_type = 'USER' AND wa.account_type = 'READER_XU' AND u.account_balance != wa.available_balance
